item.title: New DGPs appointed in Maharashtra, Haryana and Jharkhand; Full details inside
item.description: Three states usher in new police leadership as senior IPS officers take charge as Directors General of Police in Maharashtra, Haryana and Jharkhand, marking a significant administrative transition aimed at strengthening law and order and police administration.

item.title: Video: UP Minister Dinesh Pratap Singh reveals BJP strategy; Shares key insights
item.description: Uttar Pradesh Cabinet Minister Dinesh Pratap Singh speaks live on Dynamite News, revealing BJP’s 2027 assembly election strategy, cabinet plans, and his views on the party’s new national executive president.

item.title: GoI vs West Bengal: Manoj Pant extension denial sparks centre-state bureaucratic clash? Full details inside
item.description: A standoff between the Government of India and West Bengal unfolds as the Centre denies an extension to Chief Secretary Manoj Pant. Mamata Banerjee appoints Pant as Principal Secretary while Nandini Chakraborty takes charge as the state’s new Chief Secretary.

item.title: Severe cold grips North India as New Year begins; Snowfall in hills and rain likely in Delhi-UP
item.description: North India welcomed the New Year under intense cold conditions, with dense fog and chilly winds disrupting daily life. Snowfall in Himalayan states has worsened conditions, while plains face cold wave and poor visibility affecting road, rail, and air traffic. Over 300 flights were impacted. The weather department has predicted rain in Delhi-NCR and Uttar Pradesh, with dense fog likely to persist for several days.

item.title: Gold and Silver prices decline on New Year’s Day; Check latest rates
item.description: Gold and silver prices witnessed a decline on the first day of the new year, January 1. In Delhi, 24-carat gold slipped to ₹1,35,030 per 10 grams, while silver fell to ₹2,38,900 per kg. Weak global cues and profit booking impacted prices.

item.title: Sensex and Nifty open in green on New Year 2026; Rupee slips against Dollar
item.description: Indian stock markets began the year 2026 on a positive note as Sensex and Nifty opened in the green amid early buying interest. Banking, IT and auto stocks supported the gains in initial trade. However, the Indian rupee weakened by 11 paise against the US dollar, reflecting global currency pressure.

item.title: Pakistani drone spotted in Poonch on New Year; Security forces launch search operation
item.description: Security forces launched a major search operation after a Pakistani drone was spotted near the Line of Control in Jammu and Kashmir’s Poonch district on New Year’s Day. The drone reportedly remained inside Indian territory for several minutes before disappearing.

item.title: Rule Changes from January 1: LPG, cars get costlier; Big impact on household budgets
item.description: Several major rule changes came into effect from January 1, 2026, directly impacting household expenses. Commercial LPG cylinder prices were increased, making kitchens costlier, while car buyers faced price hikes by leading automakers.

item.title: AI Horoscope 2026: Gemini to see major changes and career growth; Check your prediction here
item.description: According to the AI-based Horoscope 2026, Gemini natives are set to experience a year of transformation, learning and success. Career growth is likely, especially in media, journalism, digital, IT and sales sectors, with chances of foreign opportunities.
